name: zdeclient_submit_feature_geometry
description: zDEClient::SubmitFeatureGeometry walks every clip-patch partition and submits each node/display-instance pair to the global feature map tree.
known_limits: The original non-null call-site contract is now reflected in source; tier S verification is deferred to the zDEClient feature-geometry class/source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x4575f0 validates iterating clipPatchOutput->partitionCount, advancing over 12-byte partition records, iterating each partition nodeDiPairCount, computing nodeDiPairs[pairIndex], and calling zDEClient_MapTreeState::FindOrInsertKey on the global feature map tree for each pair.

The native submit-feature-geometry smoke verifies that pairs across multiple partitions are inserted through the recovered map tree, duplicate nodes do not grow the tree, and header left/right extents match the submitted node range.
